content: Isar uwafes zinda
Haftar foila dinot, binna kub sore, mayafuwain okkole hoboror hãse aišše, ze mosolla hin loi
Heṛe hitara dekedde hoboror mukor fattorgan algaiya.
Ar hitara hoboror butore zai sadde Malik Isar laš heṛe nai.
Hitara ammuwak oi ei befare bafedde šomot, so, ujjol fušak finda duizon manuš hitarar ḍake ai tiyaiyegai.
Henot he mayafuwain okkole ḍore meṛir uzu matá nise gori taikke. He duizone hodde, "Tũwara morar butore zindare kiyolla tuwor?
Hiba eṛe nai, hiba uṛi giyoi. Galilot takite Isaye tũwarare ki hoil hin monot goro.
Hibaye endilla hoilde no ne,

content.text: 'Adomor Futore gunagaror hatot tuli diya oibo edde kurušot diya oibo. Ar tin dinor din hiba abar uṛi zaiboi.'"

content: Hetunot Isar hota hitarattu monot foijje.
Toi hitara hoborottu firi giyegoi edde he egarozon asab edde aro oinno beggunore ei hota zanaiye.

He mayafuwain okkolor butore aššilde hitara oilde: Mogdaleni Moriyam, Joanna, edde Yakubor ma Moriyam. Ar hitarar fũwati oinno mayafuwain okkol edde aro zara aššil, hitara beggune asab okkolore ei šob hota hoiye.
Kintu zara ei šob hota fuinne hitarattu hin baze hota hoiye fan laigge. Hitara mayafuwaindor hotare biššaš no gore.
Tarfore o Fitore uṛi hoboror mikka dũr diye, ar heṛe zai holla niyuri sadde šude hor fori roiye. Ar zin goiṭṭe, hinot hite tajjuf oi he zagattu firi giyegoi.
Emmaus farat zade rastat
Ar so, hedin duizon sahabi Zeruzalemottu hãt mail dure Emmaus name ek farat zadde šomot,
hitara oi šomosto goṭonar babute hotabattara hor.
Hitara hotabattara hor edde fusar asar goredde hen šomot maze Isaye nize ai hitarar fũwati ãṛa šuru goijje.
Kintu hitarar suk zen bon oi giyegoi, hetolla Isare hitara sini no fare.
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ãṛat maze ekzonore ekzone ze šob hota howa hoi goror, hin ki?"

content: Hitara nak muk hala gori tiyai roiye.
Bade zar nam Kleofas, hite hodde, "Tũi šude ekzon Zeruzalemot zoya oibo, ei hodinor butore heṛe ze goṭona okkol oiye hin no zanode."
Isaye hitarare hodde,
Hitara hodde, "In Nasarator Isar babute goṭona, ze Allah edde har mainšor šaikkat hotaye edde hame ek ḍõr kemotawala nobi aššil.
Kintu ken gori ḍõr imam edde ãrar dórmo komiṭir neta okkole moron šaza dibolla tuli diye edde kurušot mari felaiye.
Ãra aša goijjilam iba hiba, zibaye Israil zatire azad goribo. Ar hin bade o, aijja tin din oiye in okkol goiṭṭede.
Ar ãrar hozon mayafuwainde o ãrare tajjuf goijje, hitara binna kub sore Isar hoborot giye.
Hitara Isar lašor deha no fa. Ar hitara henttu firi ai zaigoi bade ãrare hoiye, hitara ze firistar okkolor deha fail hitara Isa zinda ase buli hoiye.
Ar ãrar fũwajja okkolor butottu kiye kiye hoboror hãse zai, he mayafuwainde zen hoiye, hendilla zasai goijjegoi, kintu hitara o Isare no deke."
Hetunot Isaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Tũwara hoto bekub! Ar nobi okkole ze šomosto hota hoiye, hin beggun biššaš goitte hoto durbol!
Mosiye ei šob duk bug gori nizor šanot golibolla hin gora ki zorulot no ne?"

content: Tarfore Isaye Musar ain edde šomosto nobi okkolor kitabottu šuru gori har kitabot hiba nizor babute ze šob leka ase, hin okkol hitarare buzai diye.
Tarfore hitara zeṛe zar he farar hãsa hãsi fõssiyegai. Toi Isaye aro dure zaibar alamot dehaiye.
Kintu hitara hoisali gori hodde, "Ehon din to giyegoi, hãz oi giyegoi, õne ãrar fũwati tako." Henot Isa hitarar fũwati takibolla górot góille.
Tarfore Isa zehon hitarar fũwati hána haito boišše, hetunot Isaye ruṭi loi duwa goijje edde hin bangi hitarare diya šuru goijje.
Hetunot hitarar suk kuli giyegoi, hitara Isare sini faijje. Kintu Isa hitarar hentu gayeb oi giyegoi.
Toi hitara ekzonore ekzone hodde, "Isaye ãra loi fõtot maze hota hoiyede he ṭaimot edde ãrar hãse Pak kitabor mani kuli diyede hẽtte ãrar dilor butore zoli zoli no uṛe ne?"
Ar hitara hehon uṛi Zeruzalem firi giye. Toi he egarozon asab edde hitarar fũwajja okkol beggune zomula oiya deha faiye,
ar hitara en hodde fuinne, "Malik hameka uṛi giyegoi, Simonore deha diye."
Bade itara duizone o fõtor goṭonar babute edde ruṭi bangibar šomot hitara ki bafe Isare sini faijje, he šob hota hitara beggunore funaiye.
Isaye sahabi okkolore dehaiye
Hitara ekzone ekzon loi howa hoi goredde šomot Isa nize ai hitarar maze tiyaiyegai. Hitarare hodde,
Henot hitara ḍore somki uiṭṭe. Ar hitara but dekere buli mone goijje.
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ḍoror kiyolla? Tũwarar dilot andaša ka anor?
Ãr hat ṭengor uzu so, so iba šoyong ãi. Ãre sui so, so ãre, butottu lou gusto no take zendilla ãttu asede dehor."

content: Ei hota hoi Isaye hitarare hat, ṭeng dehaiye.
Toi hitara eto kuši oiye, biššaš gori no fajjil ebbe ammuwak oi giyegoi. Toi Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwarar hãse eṛe hono kissu háibolla ase ne?"

content: Toi hitara Isare ekkan baijja mas diye.
Ar Isaye hiba loi hitarar šaikkat háiye.
Tarfore Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarar fũwati takite zin hoilam, he hota oilde endilla: Musar ain, nobi okkolor kitabot edde Zobur šorifot ãr babute ze hota leka ase hin hameka furon oibo."

content: Hetunot Isaye hitarar dil kuli diye zene hitara Pak kitabor kalam okkol buzi fare.
Toi Isaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Endilla leka ase ze: Mosittu toziya fa foribo edde tin dinor din hiba morattu uṛibo.
Ar hibar name guna maf faibolla edde mon firaibar hóbor hokkol zatir hãse tobolig gora oibo. In Zeruzalemottu šuru oibo.
So, ãr Bafe ze wada goijje he wadare ãi tũwarar hãse defeṛaiyum. Ar behostottu šokti no fo foijjonto tũwara ei šohorot taikko."

content: Isare asmanot tuli loi za oiye
Bade Isaye sahabi okkolore Betaniya foijjonto loigiye edde hitarare hat tuli duwa diye.
Toi endilla oiye, hibaye hitarare duwa gorat maze hitarattu alok oi giyegoi, edde hibare asmanot tuli loi za oiye.
Ar sahabi okkole hibare sojida goijje edde beši kuši oiyore Zeruzalem firi giyegoi.
Toi hitara hamiša dórmogórot taki Allare šukurana guzar gorat taikke.
